svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: ML platform on AWS subtitle: Amazon SageMaker AI and AWS Step Functions train and serve models; drift alarms retrain them direction: down layout: { merge: false, spacing: compact } legend: solid: Pipeline flow dashed: Retraining loop dotted: Monitoring data groups: cloud: { type: aws:cloud } region: { type: aws:region, label: us-east-1, in: cloud } pipeline: { type: aws:step-functions, label: Training pipeline, in: region } # Each stage is one row (data prep, the pipeline, serving, monitoring): `align` lines a stage's # services up side by side, so the figure folds into a block instead of a strip. nodes: raw: { icon: aws:s3, label: Amazon Simple Storage Service, note: Raw data lake, in: region } features: { icon: aws:sagemaker-ai, label: SageMaker AI Processing, note: Feature pipeline, in: region, align: raw } store: { icon: aws:sagemaker-ai, label: SageMaker AI Feature Store, note: Offline store, in: region, align: raw } train: { icon: aws:sagemaker-ai-train, label: Train, note: SageMaker AI training job, in: pipeline } evaluate: { icon: aws:lambda, label: AWS Lambda, note: Compare to baseline, in: pipeline, align: train } # Batch scoring left of the registry and the endpoint right of it: the two ways a model is served. batch: { icon: aws:sagemaker-ai, label: SageMaker AI Batch Transform, note: Nightly scoring, in: region, align: registry } registry: { icon: aws:sagemaker-ai-model, label: Model Registry, note: Approved versions, in: region } scores: { icon: aws:s3, label: Amazon S3, note: Predictions, in: region } endpoint: { icon: aws:sagemaker-ai, label: SageMaker AI endpoint, note: Real-time inference, in: region, align: registry } monitor: { icon: aws:cloudwatch-alarm, label: Drift alarm, note: Model Monitor and CloudWatch, in: region } retrain: { icon: aws:eventbridge, label: Amazon EventBridge, note: Retraining rule, in: region, align: monitor } edges: - raw -> features -> store - store -> train: training data - train -> evaluate - evaluate -> registry: register model - registry -> batch, endpoint - batch -> scores - endpoint ..> monitor: captured traffic # The retraining loop points back up at the pipeline; written in layout order with the # arrowheads at the start, so the alarm sits under the endpoint and EventBridge beside it. - { from: pipeline, to: retrain, arrow: start, line: dashed, label: StartExecution } - { from: retrain, to: monitor, arrow: start, line: dashed }

svg.title: ML platform on AWS
svg.desc: ML platform on AWS. 11 components in 3 groups. Connections: Amazon Simple Storage Service to SageMaker AI Processing; SageMaker AI Processing to SageMaker AI Feature Store; SageMaker AI Feature Store to Train (training data); Train to AWS Lambda; AWS Lambda to Model Registry (register model); Model Registry to SageMaker AI Batch Transform; Model Registry to SageMaker AI endpoint; SageMaker AI Batch Transform to Amazon S3; SageMaker AI endpoint to Drift alarm (captured traffic); Training pipeline to Amazon EventBridge (StartExecution); Amazon EventBridge to Drift alarm.

text.tspan: Amazon SageMaker AI and AWS Step Functions train and serve models; drift alarms retrain them
